page.overview:
Who is Barel-Slathborn?

Barel-Slathborn was a male Sith Lord of the old Sith Empire who was among the first inhabitants of the planet Dromund Kaas. After his death, Barel-Slathborn's spirit was trapped within the Dark Temple, and it possessed Commander Gargun when the man entered the temple.
